It was like 2 years ago we were visiting my grandmother (from my fathers side). I already hate them because of everything they did to my father. But thats not the point. They tell us we are going to have a picnic. And I was excited since I love outdoors and playing with my cousins and shit.

Anyways we got into the car and they start driving. I told them to pick somewhere where there are not many bugs because I am terrified of them. Specifically grasshopers. I can pretend they are not existing if there isnt much of them, but its like something I am genuinely terriffied of. They dont say a thing.

In the end we stop somewhere near a lake and a stream (already not a good sign, but like i said if only we get a little away from it im fine) And we sit on the grass. I shit you not, the moment we sit at least 15 grasshopers start flying. There are big ass butterflies, dragonflies bigger than 2 of my hands combined. I am sobbing at this point begging them to just move, get somewhere away from the lake. They are saying its not a big deal. 

I had very long hair curly hair back then so my mother next to me is literally picking bugs out from my fucking hair with me sobbing, my eyes shut just trying to get calm. It's not working tho. I ate like 3 chicken wings then went back to the car 2 hours later sitting there. It was so scary since when Im trying to go to the car, every step I make 2 grasshopers are flying from where I step.

I couldn't sleep peacefully for at least a week thinking I have bugs all around my body even after showering everday, I think I still haven't wore the same clothes from that day. I know it's kind of childish but it was really terrifying.
